episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: An alien crashes on Earth and hides in a remote Colorado mountain town; after assuming the identity of the town doctor, his nefarious mission is threatened when he realizes one of the townspeople, a 9-year-old boy, can see his true alien form.

episodes.title: Homesick
episodes.summary: In his first week at the clinic, Harry struggles to diagnose a strange feeling.

episodes.title: Secrets
episodes.summary: Harry tries to keep his secret; Asta faces her past.

episodes.title: Birds of a Feather
episodes.summary: Harry travels to the Ute Reservation to help Asta's grandmother; he learns what it means to belong. Harry has a surprise awaiting him when he arrives home from the Reservation.

episodes.title: Love Language
episodes.summary: An unexpected visitor teaches Harry about the human convention of marriage, which is another cultural barrier Harry must familiarize himself with to blend in with people of Earth.

episodes.title: Sexy Beast
episodes.summary: Harry copes with jealousy when the mayor hires an annoyingly perfect new town doctor.

episodes.title: The Green Glow
episodes.summary: Fearing he's facing failure, Harry enlists an unlikely ally to help find his ship.

episodes.title: End of the World As We Know It
episodes.summary: Harry must rely on Asta and D'arcy for survival.

episodes.title: Welcome Aliens
episodes.summary: Harry and Asta attend an alien convention.

episodes.title: Heroes of Patience
episodes.summary: On the verge of completing his mission, Harry faces his own humanity.

episodes.title: Old Friends
episodes.summary: Harry, the alien, is back on Earth but doesn't remember who he is and only Asta can keep him safe.

episodes.title: The Wire
episodes.summary: Harry has a plan to save Asta and himself but first he must attend the Sheriff's poker game.

episodes.title: Girls' Night
episodes.summary: Harry meets a woman unlike any other and realizes that she is the key to his new mission.

episodes.title: Radio Harry
episodes.summary: Is Harry building another bomb? Asta is going to find out as they go camping on the reservation.

episodes.title: Family Day
episodes.summary: Harry and Asta's trip is interrupted by an uninvited relative as the town celebrates family.

episodes.title: An Alien in New York
episodes.summary: Harry and Asta travel to New York looking for one of his people, but things go horribly wrong.

episodes.title: Escape from New York
episodes.summary: Harry and Asta find what they are looking for but not what they need as danger closes in.

episodes.title: Alien Dinner Party
episodes.summary: It's a surprise party as everyone gathers to celebrate Harry, but some dangerous guests cause havoc.

episodes.title: Autopsy
episodes.summary: Asta is overwhelmed with guilt after she, Harry, and D'arcy get rid of the dead body.

episodes.title: The Ghost of Bobby Smallwood
episodes.summary: Asta helps Harry learn how to deal with his newfound fear of death.

episodes.title: The Weight
episodes.summary: Asta tells Dan about the shooting; Harry learns what it takes to be a good friend.

episodes.title: The Alien Within
episodes.summary: Halloween comes to Patience, and Harry sheds his human mask.

episodes.title: Harry, a Parent
episodes.summary: After losing the alien baby, Harry learns which alien race is on Earth and it's not what he expected.

episodes.title: Cat and Mouse
episodes.summary: Harry goes head-to-head with one of his biggest enemies.

episodes.title: Best of Enemies
episodes.summary: Harry has an unexpected partner as he tries to infiltrate a military base to find his alien baby.

episodes.title: I Believe in Aliens
episodes.summary: Harry comes face to face with his greatest enemy and makes a choice that may affect Earth forever.

episodes.title: Lone Wolf
episodes.summary: In an attempt to gather information on the Grey Aliens, Harry puts Asta in harm's way.

episodes.title: The Upper Hand
episodes.summary: D'arcy inserts herself into Harry's mission, while Kate grows more uncomfortable in her own home.

episodes.title: 141 Seconds
episodes.summary: Harry tags along on Ben, Kate and Max's family trip, hoping the mayor will lead him to answers.

episodes.title: Avian Flu
episodes.summary: Harry gets distracted from his mission, while Mike and Liv make a huge discovery.

episodes.title: Lovebird
episodes.summary: Asta and D'arcy take a drastic step in an attempt to get Harry back on track.

episodes.title: Bye Bye Birdie
episodes.summary: Harry hits rock bottom. Kate begins seeing the truth. Mike helps Liv face her greatest fear.

episodes.title: Here Comes My Baby
episodes.summary: Harry and Asta get surprise visits. Ben grows suspicious of Mike and Liv's private investigation.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.summary: Harry and Asta team up with an unlikely ally to try to save the Earth.

episodes.title: Prisoners
episodes.summary: Harry must escape an outer space prison to stop a dangerous threat in town.

episodes.title: The Lonely Man
episodes.summary: Harry and Asta work together to try and get something Harry desperately needs.

episodes.title: Ties That Bind
episodes.summary: Harry and D'arcy travel to an unexpected place to recover an alien device left behind by his people.

episodes.title: Truth Hurts
episodes.summary: Harry and Heather reunite, but their relationship is more complicated than ever.

episodes.title: The Human Condition
episodes.summary: Harry struggles to find balance with his new human form.

episodes.title: Soul Providers
episodes.summary: Harry is brought in front of The Galactic Housing Council to answer for his crimes.

episodes.title: Daddy Issues
episodes.summary: Harry has to prove himself to someone from his past.

episodes.title: Mine Town
episodes.summary: Harry enlists an unlikely ally to help him save Patience.

episodes.title: Tunnel Vision
episodes.summary: With lives hanging in the balance, Harry is put to the test.

episodes.title: The End Is Here
episodes.summary: Harry faces one final threat, and one that forces him to use more than just his alien strength.
